reason: A skill-routing and workflow-orchestration plugin that selects minimal skills, audits installed skills, and uses quarantine, scanning, and explicit human approval before installing missing skills.

summaries.zh: 为任务选择最少且合适的技能，提供可编辑的路由规则、技能审计以及经隔离扫描和人工确认后才安装缺失技能的流程。
summaries.en: Routes tasks to the smallest suitable set of skills, provides editable routing and skill audits, and requires quarantine, scanning, and explicit human approval before installing missing skills.

capabilities: Routes tasks to a minimal set of skills using configurable task-to-skill rules
Audits installed skills and improves their usage descriptions on request
Quarantines and scans missing skills before installation
Records unused skill loads for future routing decisions
